title: MIC selector vector consumer ignores expected MIC byte counts
description: Correctness review finding (P4): test/vectors/mic_length_selector.json gives expected.mic_bytes for every valid vector and exists specifically to distinguish compatibility-selector wire semantics, but python/tests/test_vectors.py:4301-4324 never asserts len(frame.mic), payload boundaries, or a round trip. The separate security consumer verifies the two signed signatures/SIID values only; it does not execute the unsigned mic_bytes=0 oracle. A regression that slices selector-1 payload bytes as an unsigned MIC can evade this shared-vector consumer even though the artifact expectation changes. Execute expected.mic_bytes (and preferably exact input round-trip/payload boundary) for every valid vector.
